Fluffy Pancakes
Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | Total: 25 min

Ingredients
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp baking powder
1 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups milk
1 egg
2 tbsp melted butter

Method
Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl mix the milk, egg and melted butter.
Combine both mixtures and stir until just combined.
Cook ladlefuls of batter in a hot greased pan until golden on both sides.
